async def act(page):
    # Click on the Reports link to expand the menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Reports', exact=True)
    await reports_link.click()
    # Wait for the menu to appear; assume it becomes visible with a menu role
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Brief wait for UI update
    # Now click the Orders link; use its name and role from the accessibility tree
    # The Orders link is expected to be under a menu that appears after clicking Reports
    orders_link = page.get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=True)
    await orders_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
